integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0508498 lists version 1 on 2005-08-25 and contains the generic determinantal degree product used as the arithmetic input.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The bounded-rank matrix-variety anchor arXiv:1210.0198 is in the Algebraic Geometry category and lists primary MSC 14Q15.
integrity.proof_basis: The proof combines the classical degree product, its rectangular Schur determinant form, and Lucas theorem modulo an arbitrary prime.

scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the common prime support, not the exact common prime-power exponent when the matrix size is a nontrivial prime power.
Only generic square determinantal varieties over the complex numbers are treated.
Rectangular, symmetric, and skew-symmetric determinantal degree towers are outside scope.
An unindexed plane-partition or Schur-function source could contain the same all-ranks prime-support observation.
title: Prime-power dichotomy for common divisors of square determinantal degrees
